identitySignals: The name 'Centurisk' matches a company at centurisk.com that sells risk management software and property insurance appraisal services
Those services fit a contract for OUSD's Risk Management Department paid from a self-insurance property and liability fund
Not confirmed: no page found that links Centurisk to Oakland Unified, and no registry record (California Secretary of State, SAM.gov) was found to check location or legal entity
research.notes: Identity not confirmed against a registry or an OUSD-linked page. Centurisk's site shows no street address or phone, and a third-party profile places it in Pittsburgh, PA (not verified). The site says it operates under AssetWorks Risk Solutions, so the legal entity is unclear.

profile.summary: Centurisk provides risk management software and services, including RiskStar property risk software, property insurance appraisal services and the eRIMS risk management information system. Its website says it has helped organizations identify, quantify and manage risk for over 40 years. It lists school districts, public entities and risk pools among its clients.
